name: test-volley
title: TEST: Volley from the wall start (bench or live)
description: Volley test from the real red audience-side start, about 49.6 in from the audience cell, inside the measured shot table: expect about 3200 RPM and 5.7 deg of hood travel. Pre-aim and spin up, one volley that is skipped (never fired unready) if readiness does not arrive, then read the outcome. With balls loaded and a ready shot it feeds for 2.5 s; with no balls nothing is launched. Robot on blocks for a bench run, or on the practice field for a live one. Cleared area, hand on STOP.

pose.provenance: TEST ROUTINE: the real red audience-side start (robot facing -X, left side on the audience wall, back about 1.4 in from the centre line; 396 x 374 mm chassis). Bench runs can sit anywhere: the pose only decides where the turret thinks the hive is.

steps.name: aim
steps.notes: Latches the audience cell and starts yaw/hood tracking and the flywheel. Watch 'Targets yaw / hood / flywheel': about 3200 RPM and 5.7 deg hood.
Let the flywheel come up and the turret settle before the volley.

steps.name: volley
steps.notes: SKIP: if turret, hood and RPM are not ready within 3 s nothing is fed. Expect SUCCESS 'Volley fed 2.5 s', or TIMEOUT 'SKIPPED: not ready in time'.
Read 'Last bounded action' now (step, outcome and reason).
